item.description:
## Changes
- Gemini transcription now deletes the transcript Google keeps of each part as soon as Ahoy has it, as it already did for the uploaded audio. Google would otherwise keep it for 55 days on a paid key. - Links written by the AI in insights, the call assistant and Ask open only if they are secure web links (https), and show their address when you point at them. Other links stay plain text, so words said in a call can't plant a link that opens something on your Mac. - Stop no longer hangs at "Finishing" when the network drops silently during a call with live captions; the recording closes within a few seconds. - Ahoy uses much less of your Mac while recording: the window no longer redraws everything every second, and imports and model downloads no longer slow the Dashboard down. - Action items, the call screen, the transcript search and Ask respond faster with a large library and long calls; typing in Ask no longer lags with long answers. - Re-export all no longer freezes the app with a large library, and ticking items done, renaming speakers or starring a call no longer pauses the window while its files are rewritten. - Whisper uses far less memory on long calls (it reads the recording in 10-minute pieces), which matters most on Macs with 8 GB. - Long uploads to Soniox and AssemblyAI use less memory. - A device switch that makes macOS's audio system stall can no longer slow the rest of the app down, and a long freeze no longer makes Ahoy restart a microphone that was working. - A call that couldn't be recovered after a crash can be moved to the Trash right away. - Fixed a rare crash when Gemini returned a malformed timestamp.

## Changes
- Setup asks one question: keep everything on this Mac (free; it downloads what it needs, with the progress right there) or use an online service with your own API key (it shows about what an hour costs). Your answer sets transcription, summaries and live captions together. - "Keep everything on this Mac" now really does: the new Settings → Transcription → Only transcribe on this Mac makes a call wait for a downloaded model instead of going to Gemini. - Ask says when it can't answer yet, because no insights engine is set up, and links to Settings → Insights, instead of failing after you send a question. - Every call on the Dashboard shows its day and date, how long it lasted in minutes, and the app only once; the cards are shorter. - The Dashboard's Ask and Action items tiles are smaller and quieter, and the Ask field no longer takes the keyboard when the Dashboard opens. The header's "Move to Trash" button is now "Select…". - A call's screen says where its audio was transcribed ("Transcribed on this Mac", "Transcribed by Gemini (Google)", …) and where Transcribe again would send it next time. - Action items show Edit and Send to Reminders when you point at an item; they are always in the right-click menu and available to VoiceOver. - Messages about a missing key or model say what they are for (asking questions or writing insights), and inside Settings they name the section instead of sending you to Settings. - Settings explanations start with what stays on your Mac and what is sent where; card titles line up with their settings, and the app language has its own row. - The empty Dashboard says Ahoy is watching for calls, and whether it will ask before recording. - The recording pill's Discard button is a trash can. - The audio player sits below the call instead of floating over it. - Insights list action items as plain bullets; tick them off in Action items. - The permission buttons in setup no longer get cut off.

## Changes
- Error messages now say what went wrong in plain words, instead of internal names like "accessDenied" or "The operation couldn't be completed": a microphone or system audio that won't start (with the setting to check), a recording whose audio can't be read, a reply from Gemini that couldn't be read, a call whose audio couldn't be recovered after a crash, and failed model downloads. - Banners at the top of the window (Undo after moving to the Trash, imports) slide in and out instead of pushing the page down at once, and a call moved to the Trash disappears smoothly; Undo brings it back the same way. - The red dot in the recording pill gently pulses while Ahoy is recording. - The transcription percentage counts up instead of jumping. - Copying a call's insights shows a checkmark for a moment, so you know it worked. - With Reduce motion on in System Settings, all of these happen instantly.
